# 1 Clement Chapter 48 — The EMET Bible (Literal)

**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Codex Alexandrinus, 1 Clement 48 | **Source Image:** source-texts/greek-EC/1CL_048_page_001.jpg

---

## Chapter 48

**48:1** Let us therefore heal these breaches swiftly and fall down before the Master and weep, and beseech him that he show himself merciful and be reconciled to us, and restore us to the honorable and pure conduct that belongs to our brotherly love.

**48:2** For this is the gate of righteousness opened unto life, as it is written: "Open to me the gates of righteousness; entering through them I will confess the LORD.

**48:3** This is the gate of the LORD; the righteous shall enter through it."

**48:4** Therefore, though many gates are opened, the gate of righteousness is this which is in Christ; in which all are blessed who enter, and direct their way in holiness and righteousness, accomplishing all things without disorder.

**48:5** Let a man be faithful, let him be able to speak forth knowledge, let him be wise in the interpretation of discourses, let him be pure in deeds —

**48:6** for the more he seems to be great, so much the more it becomes him to be humble, and to seek the common advantage of all and not his own.

---

*EMET renders the Greek of Codex Alexandrinus with maximal literalness.*
